metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: What kind of questions would you ask?

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: The following is a conversation with Oliver Stone. He's one of the greatest filmmakers of all time

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: with three Oscar wins and 11 Oscar nominations. His films tell stories of war and power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Fearlessly and often controversially shining a light on the dark parts of American and global

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: history. His films include Platoon, Wall Street, Born on the Fourth of July, Scarface, JFK, Nixon,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Alexander, W, Snowden, and documentaries where he has interviewed some of the most powerful

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: and consequential people in the world including Fidel Castro, Hugo Chavez, and Vladimir Putin.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: And in this conversation, Oliver and I mostly focus our discussion on Vladimir Putin,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Russia, and the war in Ukraine. My goal with these conversations is to understand the human

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: being before me. To understand not just what they think, but how they think. To steel man their

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: ideas and to steel man the devil's advocate. All in service of understanding, not derision.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: I have done this poorly in the past. I'm still struggling with this, but I'm working hard to

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: do better. I believe the moment we draw lines between good people and evil people will lose

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: our ability to see that we're all one people in the most fundamental of ways. And lose track of

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: the deep truth expressed by the old Solzhenitsyn line that I return to time and time again. That

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: the line between good and evil runs to the heart of every man. Oliver Stone has a perspective

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: that he extensively documents in his powerful controversial series, The Untold History of the

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: United States. That imperialism and the military industrial complex paved the path to absolute

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: power and thus corrupt the minds of the leaders and institutions that wield it. From this perspective,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: the way out of the humanitarian crisis and human suffering in Ukraine and the way out from the

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: pull of the beating drums of nuclear war is not simple to understand, but we must because all of

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: humanity hangs in the balance. I will talk to many people who seek to understand the way out of this

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: growing catastrophe, including to historians, to leaders, and perhaps most importantly, to people

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: on the ground in Ukraine and Russia. Not just about war and suffering, but about life, friendship,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: family, love, and hope. This is the Lex Friedman podcast. To support it, please check out our

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: sponsors in the description. And now dear friends, here's Oliver Stone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: You're working on a documentary now about nuclear energy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: So it's interesting to talk about this. Energy is such a big part of the world, about geopolitics

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: of the world, about the way the world is. What do you think is the role of nuclear energy in the

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: 21st century?

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Good question. First of all, obviously, everyone's talking about climate change, right? So here I wake

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: up to that a few years ago, and clearly we're concerned. I picked up a book by Josh Goldstein

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: and his co-author, who's Swedish. Those two wrote a book called Bright Future, A Bright Future. It

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: came out a few years ago, and I lapped it up. It was a book fact-based, clear, not too long,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: and not too technical. And it was very clear that they were in favor of all kinds of renewables,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: renewable energy, yes. They made it very clear how dangerous oil and gas were, methane, and made it

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: very clear to the layman like me, and at the same time said that this renewables can work so far.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: But the gap is enormous as to how much electricity the world is going to need in 2050 and beyond.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Two, three, four times we don't even know the damage, but we have India, we have China,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: we have Africa, we have Asia coming onto the scene wanting more and more electricity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: So they addressed the problem as a global one, not just as often in the United States. You get

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: the ethnocentric United States point of view that we know we're doing well, blah, blah, blah. We're

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: not doing well, but we sell that to people that were comfortable. We spend more energy than anybody

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: in this country per capita than anybody. And at the same time, we don't seem to understand

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: the global picture. So that's what they did, and they made me very worried. So the only way to

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: close that gap, the only way in their mind is nuclear energy, and talking about a gap of building

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: a huge amount of reactors over the next 30 years and starting now. They make that point over and

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: over again. So obviously this country, the United States, is not going to go in that direction,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: because it just is incapable of having that kind of will, political will. And fear is a huge factor,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: and still a lot of shibboleths, a lot of myths about nuclear energy have confused and confounded

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: the landscape. The environmentalists have played a huge role in doing good things, many good things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: but also confusing and confounding the landscape and making accusations against nuclear energy that

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: were exaggerated. So taking all these things into consideration, we set about making this documentary,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: which is about finished now, almost finishing. It's an hour and 40 minutes, and that was a hard

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: part, getting it down from about three and a half hours to about this, something more manageable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: And is it interviews?

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: It's interviews among others, but essentially we went to Russia, we went to France, which is the

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: most perhaps advanced nuclear country in the world, Russia and the United States. We went to the

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Idaho laboratory and talked to the scientists there, as well as the Department of Energy people

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: that are handling this. Idaho is one of the experimental labs, the United States is probably

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: one of the most advanced, and they're doing a lot of advanced nuclear there. We also, we studied,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: well, Russia gave us a lot of insight. We're very cooperative because they have some of the

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: most advanced nuclear, actually the probably most advanced nuclear reactor in the world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: the Beloyarsk, the Ural Mountains. So we did an investigation there. And in France, they have

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: some very advanced nuclear reactors in their building. Now they're building again. The Green

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Party came into power, just not into power, but became a factor in France, and there was a motion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: When Hollande was president, they started to move away from it. Actually, they were beginning to

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: just abandon, they let not complete their, in other words, let close down some of the nuclear

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: reactors. There was talk of that, but thank God, France did not do that. And Macron came in and

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: recently reversed it, and they're building as fast as they can now, especially with the Ukraine war

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: going on. There's an awareness that Russia will not be providing, may not be providing the energy

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Europe needs. And then China is the other one too. That's the other factor. I'm talking about the big

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: boys. They have doing tremendous work and fast, which is very hopeful. But of course, China is

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: building in all directions at once. Coal continues to be huge in China and methane too. But basically,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: coal in India, in China, the biggest users of coal. And as you know, Germany went back to coal

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: a few years ago. So all these factors, it's fascinating picture globally. So we try to

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: achieve a consensus that where nuclear can work and where it will be working, it will be used more

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: and more. The question is how much carbon dioxide China and Russia will be putting out. France is

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: the only one that's not putting it out. The United States has not changed with all the talk and all

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: the nonsense about renewables and the new lifestyle and all this. It's great for your guilt complex,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: but it doesn't do anything for the total accumulation of carbon dioxide in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Who's going to lead the way on nuclear, do you think? You mentioned Russia, France, China,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: United States, who's going to lead? Yeah, I don't think it's going to be a

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: United Nations kind of thing because the world doesn't seem capable of uniting. We don't,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: we go to these conferences, Kyoto, and we talk and we agree, but then we don't actually enforce.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: So I don't think it can happen that way. I think it's going to be an individual race with countries.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: They're going to just do it for their own self-interest like China is doing it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: The thing is if it works, and I'm praying that it will really work on a big scale,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: China will back away from coal naturally. The same thing will be true of India. They will see

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: the benefits because if you go to India, you see the cities, the pollution, you walk around in

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: that stuff and you get, there's no hope in this and you sense it. So people will move in this

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: direction naturally because nuclear is clean energy. And the amount of casualties of nuclear

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: is the lowest on the industrial scale for energy producing from coal down to oil, everything. The

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: lowest casualty rate, very lowest, 0.002 or something is nuclear. So not that many people

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: have died from nuclear, not that many. I think 50 people at Chernobyl, which was the worst accident.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Nobody had died at Fukushima. Nobody died at Three Mile Island. And that's what you hear all over

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: and over again, these accidents. The environmentalists have sold us the idea that they're dangerous. And

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: it's a lot of environmentalists, thank God, have changed. They've come off that routine and they've

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: seen this, we were wrong. We've done a lot of good work. Greenpeace did a lot of good work. Whale,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: saving this, saving that. But they admit themselves, not they don't, but people who

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: have been in the organization have said we were wrong. In 1956, we show the articles in the New

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: York Times that came out, the Rockefeller Foundation, which of course is a big producer of oil,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: the Rockefeller family. And the foundation came out with a study which was weighted.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: They tipped the scale, put a thumb on the scale, but it was a scientific expose of radiation

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: in the study that came out printed in the New York Times because the New York Times publisher,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Salzburger, was on their board. He was one of the board members. So they got a lot of

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: strong publicity condemning radiation, which started the process of doubting nuclear energy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: The radiation levels that they pointed out were very minor. And of course, if you go into a

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: scientific analysis of this now with what we know, it's just not true. But it tilted the scale back

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: in the 50s, 60s and started the questioning the nuclear business. Do you think that was malevolence

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: or incompetence? No, I think it was competition. I don't think it was conspiracy as much as it was

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: a sense that we don't want this nuclear energy is going to end the dominance of oil. Absolutely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: And it will. And it will anyway, because it's the only sane way for the world to proceed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: But the world will have to learn through adversity. So in other words, this situation

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: could get worse, much worse. And certain countries are just going to have to adapt like we always do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: When things become too hard, you've got to go, you have to change your thinking. And humans are

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: pretty good at that. Yes, talking about human nature, they're very adept at that. Germany,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: for example, I mean, they were when the Fukushima happened, they went out of the nuclear business.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: That was shocking to me. They just pulled out and they destroyed,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: they destructed several of their nuclear reactors that were still functioning and put up coal and oil

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: replaced. And as a result, Germany drifted into this place next to France. Their electricity bills

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: went up and France stayed the same. They have a different system in Europe, but more or less,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: no question that France was doing a lot better than Germany. And now with this Ukraine issue,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: it's a very interesting fulcrum point, whether Germany is, what direction they're going to go now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: How can they keep going with coal? They just can't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: What's the connection between oil, coal, nuclear and war, sort of energy and conflict?

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Do you see, when you look at the 21st century, when you were doing this documentary,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: were you thinking of nuclear as a way to power the world, but is it also to avoid conflict over

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: resources? Is there some aspect to energy being a source of conflict that we're trying to avoid?

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: That we're trying to avoid? I don't have the energy,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: the history of energy at my fingertips and it's a very long history here. But I would say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: apparently not. It does seem that individually each country can answer its needs by building.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: And up until now, we haven't had conflict except in this issue of Russia supplying Europe. Obviously,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: the pipeline Nord Stream 2 has been closed and Nord Stream 1 is also probably going to be phased

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: out. And the concept of Russia supplying gas to Europe is now up in the air and who knows what's

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: going to happen. I just don't see how Europe can get away from using Russian gas. But Russian gas

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: is not the solution because it's methane too and it goes up into the atmosphere. Methane in a short

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: term is worse than coal, worse. There's all kinds of charts we show in the film. We try not to be

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: too over factual. But methane is not the answer. It's a short term answer. Will countries go to

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: war over energy is a question that I'm trying to think of all the wars that happened. You could

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: say Germany, of course, during World War II needed oil very badly and it dictated their strategy

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: with Romania, etc. Getting the oil fields open. But I haven't thought that one through. I'd have

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: to make a documentary on it to really understand how energy and war interface. It's always part of

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: the calculation, but it's a question of how much. That's the question. I just have to ask because

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: you mentioned your mom is from France. You've traveled for this documentary and you traveled

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: in general throughout the world in Russia, Ukraine. What are the defining characteristics

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: of these cultures? Let's go with Russia. As I told you, I'm half Ukrainian, half Russian.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: I came from that part of the world. What are some interesting, beautiful aspects of the culture

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: of Russia and Ukraine? I can't really speak honestly of Ukraine. I was there only in 1983

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: when I visited the Soviet Union under the communism. Kiev was beautiful. It was one of

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: the nicer places I went, but they were very much stultified by the communist system. They all were.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: The best places to visit in Russia were always in the south, whether Georgia or the Muslim countries.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: It was always a better culture in terms of comfort, but communism was rough and that was

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: the end of it pretty much. Brezhnev regime and then Andropov and Gorbachev was three years in

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: the future when I was there. I can't talk about Ukraine. They've not been friendly to me since

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: ISIS. Of course, since I made the Putin interviews, Ukraine has banned me, I believe. They've been

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: very tough on people who are critical. I think the Russian people have been very special to me,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: and perhaps because of my European upbringing, but I enjoy talking to them. I find them very open,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: very generous, and they appreciate support. They appreciate people who say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: I understand why your government is doing this or this or this. I've tried to stay open-minded and

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: listen to both sides. The thing that I have seen as an American is, of course,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: this American enmity towards Russia from the very beginning. I grew up in 1946. I was born

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: in the 50s. It was so anti-Russian. They were everywhere. They were in our schools,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: they were in our state department, they were spying on us, they were stealing the country from us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: That was the way the American right wing, not even the right wing, I'd say the Republican party,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: pictured the Russians. They were actively engaged in infiltrating America and changing our thinking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Television shows were based on this. It was very much the J. Edgar Hoover mentality,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: that communism was even behind the student protests of the 1960s. This was the direction

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: in which the FBI and the CIA were thinking. I grew up with a prejudice. It took me many years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: My father was a Republican, and he was a stockbroker, and he was a very intelligent man.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: But even he, because he was a World War II soldier, he was a colonel, had fallen under

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: the influence. In order to be successful in American business in the 1950s, you had to have

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: a very strong anti-Soviet line. Very strong. You wouldn't get ahead if you expressed any kind of,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: let's end this Cold War, any kind of activity of that nature. You'd be cast aside as a pinko or

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: somebody who was not completely on the board with the American way of doing business, which was

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: capitalism works, communism doesn't. And in particular, communism as embodied by

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: the Soviet Union is the enemy. So hence the narrative behind the Cold War.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: That's correct. It basically lasted. I mean, you saw the ups and downs of it. When Reagan came in,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: I was, well, first of all, we had the crisis of 1962 with the Cuban Missile Crisis, and Kennedy

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: proved himself to be a warrior for peace. He resolved that with Khrushchev. That was a big

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: moment, huge moment. And people don't give him credit enough for really saving us from a war

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: that could have affected all of mankind. But it still didn't avert.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: No, because the moment he was killed, honestly, there was a lot of, we can talk about that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: And as you know, I've made a film, JFK Revisited is a documentary we released this year

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: about the movie I made in 1991. But the moment he was killed, I would argue that Lyndon Johnson

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: went back immediately to the old way of thinking, the old way of doing business, which was the

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Eisenhower Truman way, which we had adapted since World War II. That was an interim. You have to

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: think about it from Roosevelt dies in 45, Roosevelt has an interim of 15 years where he

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: has more of a democratic regime, more liberal. He establishes, he recognizes the Soviet Union for the

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: first time since the revolution, and he actually has a relationship with them. He sends ambassadors

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: who are friendly and he has a relationship with Stalin, etc. And at Yalta,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: and, no, at Tehran rather, is where he had the relationship.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Do you think if JFK lived, we would not have a Cold War?

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: No, absolutely not. And we go into great depth on that in the film, and I urge you to see it

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: because it goes into all the issues around the world. Kennedy was being very much an anti-imperialist,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: it turns out, and many people don't understand that. But you have to look at all his policies

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: in Middle East with Nasser, he had a relationship with Sukarno in Indonesia, with Latin America,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: he made a big effort with the Alliance for Progress. And when Africa, above all, with Lumumba,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: he was very shocked at his death and tried to defend the integrity of the Belgian Congo

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: with Dag Hammarskjöld of the UN. He made a big effort. Unfortunately, it didn't work out

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: because Dag Hammarskjöld was killed and then Kennedy was killed, and Congo descended into

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: the chaos of Joseph Mabutu's dictatorship. But Kennedy was very active in terms of, as an

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Irishman, not as an Englishman, he was an Irishman. And I say that because, well, we'll come back to

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: that because Mr. Joe Biden is an Irishman, but it's a different kind of an Irishman. They're

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: both Catholic Irish, but Kennedy really made an effort to change the imperialist mindset

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: that still was strong in America and Europe. Lyndon Johnson changed back to the old policy

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: and we were never able to really keep the talk going with the Russians. Briefly had it with Carter,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: but then Brzezinski came in. Brzezinski was his national security advisor. He was put there by

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Rockefeller and Brzezinski was a Pole. He got revenge from Poland. Poland has always been

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: attacking Russia as far as I remember back to another century. I mean, the two world wars that

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: occupied Russia and so tragically, entry points were always through Poland and Ukraine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: So Brzezinski got his revenge and Carter ended up being an enemy of the Soviet Union. And

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: as Brzezinski took pride in it, he created the atmosphere of the trap for the Soviets to go into

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Afghanistan in 79. That trap was set, he said, in 1978. So there was never except for brief moments

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: of periods of detente with the Soviets. And I grew up under that. I didn't really know anything of

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: this going on because I was learning. I was educating myself as I was going, learning movies

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: and trying to be a dramatist and this and that. So I wasn't thinking about this. Then when Reagan

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: came in, I was worried again because it was a beat of the old beat, which was there, the most evil

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: empire. I mean, it goes on in American history. It doesn't end. Reagan got a lot of points for that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: And of course, when Gorbachev came in, it was a beautiful moment for the world. It was a great

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: surprise. It was probably the best years for America, at least from my point of view,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: in terms of this relaxation in the mood. 1986 to 1991 were great years in terms of ability

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: to believe once again that there could be a peace dividend. But the world changed again in 1991,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: 92. There's an internal mechanism, who knows? You could blame the United States, you could blame

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Russia for... Gorbachev was perhaps not the right man to try to administer that country at that

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: point. He had great visions. He was a man of peace, but it was very difficult to hold together such a

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: huge empire. So vision is not enough to hold together the Soviet Union. I think the details

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: are interesting. I followed up on that a little bit because I was recently in countries like

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Kazakhstan, talked about the negotiations that were going on and the breakup of the Soviet Union.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: It's a very interesting story because it involves everything, Ukraine, of course,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: everything that's going on now. Some, what is it, 30 million Russians were left outside of the

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Soviet Union when it collapsed. They had no home anymore. They were homes in other countries such

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: as in Ukraine. So it's an interesting story and with repercussions today. Kazakhstan is a good

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: example of keeping a balance, keeping it neutral. He played both sides because Yeltsin wanted him to

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: join the Russian Confederation in a certain way where he'd be supporting against Gorbachev.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: There's a whole inward battle there. I think the Ukraine came along with Yeltsin as well as

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: I'm sorry, I don't remember now, but two other regions came with him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: And that was a block that broke up the Soviet Union. It was Yeltsin's plan to, and it wasn't

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: make the Russian Federation and they did. I would love to return back to JFK eventually

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: because he's such a fascinating figure in the history of human civilization. But let me ask

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: you fast forward in 2000, Yeltsin was no longer president and Vladimir Putin became president.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: You did a series of interviews with Vladimir Putin, as you mentioned, over a period of two years,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: from 2015 to 2017. Let me ask with a high level question. What was your goal with that country?

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: What was that conversation? Oh, came out in 2017. I guess I started them in 2014.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: At that point, the Snowden affair had happened. I was working on a movie on Snowden that happened

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: in 2013. Ukraine happened in 2014. And one thing after another, by 2014,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Putin was enemy number, again, becoming a wanted man on the American list. He was enemy. He was

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: certainly in the top five. But the animosity towards Putin had been growing since 2007 at Munich.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: I remember that speech when he made it. It's in my documentary. It's a four-hour documentary,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: four different conversations. I mean, we talked over two years, two and a half years. But I remember

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: that image of him at Munich making a very important speech about world harmony, about the

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: balance necessary in the world. And I remember the sneer on John McCain's face. He was in Munich

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: obviously eyeballing Putin and hating him. And it was so evident that McCain had no belief whatsoever

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: that he was almost treating him like, these are the communists are back. And we know that Putin

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: was not a communist. We know that Putin is very much a market man. And he made it very clear and

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: tried to keep an open climate, a new relationship with Europe. But certain people in the United

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: States always saw that as a threat, like Putin is trying to take Europe away from us as if we own

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: it, as if we have the right to own it. But Putin was making the point, it's very important, about

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: sovereignty. Sovereignty for countries is crucial for this new world to have balance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: That's sovereignty for China, sovereignty for Russia, sovereignty for Iran, sovereignty for

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Venezuela, sovereignty for Cuba. This is an idea that's crucial to the new world. And I think the

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: United States has never accepted that. Sovereignty is not an idea that they can allow. You have to be

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: obedient to the United States idea of so-called democracy and freedom. But it's much more

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: important is sovereignty for these countries. And the United States has not obeyed that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: has not even acknowledged it. And it never comes up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: So from the perspective of the United States, when power centers arise in the world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Yeah. It's not just aggressive. So I obviously speak Russian, so I get to appreciate both the

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: original and the translation. And it's not just aggressive. It's very shallow. They're not looking

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: to understand. To me, aggression is okay if that's the way you want to approach it. But there should

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: be underlying kind of empathy for another human being in order to be able to understand. And so

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: the, some of the worst interviews I've ever listened to is by American press of Vladimir Putin.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: So NBC and all those kinds of organizations, it's very painful to watch. And you saw the reception

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: can do you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: I take that into account. I absolutely take that into account. I know, I mean, doing Castro,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286
