metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: account, but Putin doesn't play that game. He doesn't charm you. He doesn't try to overwhelm you

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: with his bon ami at all. He just says, I'll ask you a question, I'll give you my answer straight.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Here it is. And he analyzes it. This is the history of NATO. This is the history of our

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: relationship with the United States. How many times have we tried to talk to them about such

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: and such and such and such and each time we get nowhere? In fact, it's a very,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: I would like to get along with the United States so much. He's saying it so clearly in all his words.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: So to play devil's advocate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: But he's not making a big deal about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: But there is a charisma and the calmness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Yes, there is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: So like, let's just calm everything down. It's simple facts. That you can call. So there's like

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: the Hitler thing, which is screaming, being very loud, charismatic, strong message and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: And then there's a Putin style. I'm not comparing those two. There's the style communication of

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: calmness. And that, at least to me, my personality, that can be very captivating,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: is bringing everything down. The facts are simple. But then when you say the facts are simple,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: you can now start lying and you don't know what's true and what's not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: It behooves you to do some research.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: And frankly, when it comes to research, you're going to have a problem. Because if you go to

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: the Americanized versions of Russian history, you're going to run into a problem. And that

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: includes even Wikipedia. They will tell you things that are just not factually supported.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: So it was a problem in terms of if you read all the books in the American library about Putin,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: there's nothing positive about it. They're awful. They're awful. And a lot of them, I had a good

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: relationship with Professor Stephen Cohen, who's the most, I think, one of the most informed men

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: on Russia. He'd done a lot of research all his life and knew Gorbachev very well and was very

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: analytical about all these situations that happened before his death in 2019. I'm not quite sure when

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Stephen died, but I knew him well. And he gave me the best information I could get. I would go to

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Stephen and I'd say, I'm confused here. Tell me the history of this accusation of poisoning

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: against this person and so forth. And he'd explain it to me in, I think, the clearest ways that I

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: understood. And he said to me once, he said, most of these people who go to Russia and write this

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: stuff about Putin are going off the internet. The internet has really been a source of a lot of

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: fractured facts here. He said, pure analysis. You have to go back to the texts, all the documents,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: and to really fully understand. But he spoke Russian and his wife and him, Katarina Vanhul,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: who's an editor, publisher of The Nation magazine, would go to Russia several times a year and talk

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: to their friend Gorbachev. Gorbachev's an interesting character. I talked to him,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: interviewed him, not interviewed him, but talked to him at length. And I like him very much.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: And I saw the divide, as you saw in the Putin interviews between Gorbachev and Putin early on

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: in the interviews, you sense Putin doesn't particularly care for Gorbachev because he,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: in his point of view, he screwed up the administration of Russia and is responsible

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: for so much of the disaster of leaving all those people outside the Soviet Union.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: So these are problems that continue into the future. But

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: they see each other at the – or he sees, he knows he's there at the May Day Parade,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: I – we filmed. And his attitude is funny, it's very human. He says, you know, he's welcome,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: he's got his pension, he's a pensioner, he's done his duty. There's no animus towards him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: And even when Gorbachev in the early days, as you remember, criticized for his manners in terms of

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: democracy, but I don't know that that, you know, that becomes a quarrel. But frankly, by the end

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: of the situation, it's very clear that Gorbachev has now moved closer and closer to the – says

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Russia is now really under attack. This is – he sees where the United States has made a concerted

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: effort to undermine Putin. And he does – and he's repeated this several times about Ukraine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: I think you've seen what he said. You can quote it. And Gorbachev is – we have no respect for

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Gorbachev even, even at this juncture. When can you see Gorbachev's ideas printed in most American

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: newspapers? Very rarely, very rarely, and recently not at all. So Gorbachev, who was our hero back in,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: an American hero back in the 1980s, has now been condemned to the garbage can, so to speak, of history.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Well, in this complicated geopolitical picture you just outlined,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: can we talk about the recent invasion of Ukraine? You wrote on Facebook a pretty eloquent analysis,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: I think on March 3rd. Let me just read a small section of that just to give context,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: and maybe we can talk a little bit more about both Russia and the man Putin.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: You wrote, although the United States has many wars of aggression on its conscience,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: it doesn't justify Mr. Putin's aggression in Ukraine. A dozen wrongs don't make a right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Russia was wrong to invade. It has made too many mistakes. One, underestimating Ukraine resistance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Two, overestimating the military ability to achieve its objective. Three, underestimating

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Europe's reaction, especially Germany, upping its military contribution to NATO, which they've

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: resisted for some 20 years. Even Switzerland has joined the cause. Russia will be more isolated

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: than ever from the West. Four, underestimating the enhanced power of NATO, which will now put more

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: pressure on Russia's borders. Five, probably putting Ukraine into NATO. Six, underestimating

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: the damage to its own economy and certainly creating more internal resistance in Russia.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Seven, creating a major readjustment of power in its oligarch class. Eight, putting cluster and

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: vacuum bombs into play. Nine, and underestimating the power of social media worldwide. And you go

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: on for a while giving a much broader picture of the history and the geopolitics of all of this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: So now, a little bit later, two months later, what are your thoughts about the invasion

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: of Ukraine? Well, it's very hard to be honest in this regard because the West has brought down a

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: curtain here and anyone who questions the invasion of Ukraine and its consequences is

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: an enemy of the people, it's become so difficult. I've never seen in my lifetime ever such a

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: wall of propaganda as I've seen in the West. And that includes France too because I was there

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: recently in England. England is of course really vociferous. It's shocking to me how quickly Europe

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: moved in this direction and that includes Germany. I have German friends who expressed to me their

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: shock over Ukraine. I have Italian friends, same thing. And Italy of course has been perhaps the

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: most understanding and compassionate of countries. So it's quite evident that there's a united – and

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: this attests to the power of the United States. And of course you have Finland, which has generally

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: been reasonable jumping in talking about joining NATO and Sweden too. And I think that's a very

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: good point. And generally there's been some more restraint in Europe. That's what surprised me the

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: most, Europe. How quickly they fell into this NATO basket, which is very dangerous for Europe,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: very dangerous. This goes back to my idea what I was saying earlier about sovereignty. These

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: countries don't really give me a sense that they have sovereignty over their own countries. They

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: don't feel – I'm obviously intuition here is working. I just don't feel that they have freedom

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: to say what they really think and they're scared to say it. When the United States invaded Iraq in

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: 2003, I remember with great, in a sense, satisfaction that at least France,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Chirac, who I had not really known much about, stood up and said, the United States, we're not

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: going to join you in this expedition, basically into madness. Schroeder and Germany, same thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Of course, Putin condemned the invasion and Putin had been an ally of the United States since 9-11,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: if you remember correctly, and had called Bush and they were getting along. So even Putin said,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: I won't go, don't go into Iraq. This is not the solution. He didn't oppose Afghanistan,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: but he opposed Iraq. So Chirac and Schroeder stood for the old Europe. I remember de Gaulle,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Charles de Gaulle. He was independent of the United States. Charles de Gaulle pulled France

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: out of NATO because he saw the dangers of NATO, which is to say, you have to fight an American war

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: when they say, and they put nuclear weapons on your territory in England and France and Italy and

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Germany. When they do that, you're hitched to this superpower and you have no say in what they're

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: going to do. If they declare war and they use your territory, you're going to be involved in

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: a major conflict. I'm talking about sovereignty. Where is that sovereignty? They don't have it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: And that has influenced their mindset for years now. Since 1940, well, de Gaulle was the 60s.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: He actually reversed the whole flow and I think it was Sarkozy who put France back into NATO.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: And now it's Macron, I hope because he was talking to Putin, would at least

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: have an independent viewpoint that could be helpful here. So he rolled it up. He may have

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: told Putin something else, but within days he had rolled it up and gone along with the United States

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: position, which was enforced by the United States in a very fierce way. The propaganda, as I say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: I don't know how much time you spent in America, but it was vicious and everything was anti-Russian.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Russia were killing all these people, were shooting down civilians, although there was no proof of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: There was just these are the accidents of war, but all of a sudden it was a campaign of criminality

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: and they were talking about bringing Putin into war crime trial. Well, why didn't they talk like

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: that when Iraq was going on and Bush was killing far more people? Or for that matter, why were

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: they not talking about the killings in Donbas and Lugansk during that 2014 to 2022 period?

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: That is what is, it's a crime. There were so many people that were killed, many of them innocent,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: many of them innocent. So what would be the way for Vladimir Putin to stop the killing in Donbas

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: without the invasion of Ukraine? Yeah, that's a very good question and I've asked that several times

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: and I have not talked to him since about two years now. It's a very good question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: What's the mistakes, what the human mistakes and the leadership mistakes means?

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: That's a very good question. You see, what the American press has not said and the

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Western press has not said is that on February 24, that was on that day when they invaded.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: The day before, if you check the logs of the European organization that was supervising,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: it was in the field in Ukraine. These are neutral observers. They were seeing heavier and heavier

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: artillery fire going into Donbas from the Ukrainian side. So they had, apparently,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Ukraine had 110,000 troops on the border. They were about to invade Donbas. That was the plan.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: That's what I think. Russia, because of the buildup on the border of Donbas, brought 130,000,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: they say 130,000 troops to the area near Donbas. So you have buildup of forces on both sides,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: but you wouldn't know that from reading the press in the West. You would believe that the Russians

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: suddenly put all these men into the situation with the idea of invading Ukraine, not only Donbas,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: but invading all of Ukraine and getting rid of the decapitating the government there,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: which is all assumption. We don't know what they would intend it to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: But you at the time, is it a lot of people thought that all the talk of the invasion,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Russian invasion of Ukraine is just propaganda. It's not going to happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: It's very unlikely to happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: I think many of us thought that the United States is building this up into an invasion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: In other words, that is the nature of false flag operations. When you create this propaganda,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: they are going to invade, they are going to invade. And then when they invaded,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: the United States was completely ready and all their allies were completely ready for the invasion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Correct? So why did Putin do that? He fell into this, theoretically into this trap

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: set by the United States. Here you're telling all your allies across the board,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: they're going to invade. But you-

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Why do you think he did it? Is it madness or is it common strategic calculation?

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Perhaps. This one I cannot answer you faithfully because first of all, we don't know what he was

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: told. If he was indeed getting the right intelligence estimates from what I said earlier

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: in that essay I wrote, you would think he was not well-informed perhaps about the degree

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: of cooperation he would get from the Ukrainian Russians in Ukraine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: I- That would be one factor that he didn't assess the operation correctly. Remember this,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Mr. Putin has had this cancer and I think he's licked it, but he's also been isolated because

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: of COVID. And some people would argue that the isolation from normal activity, which he was

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: meeting people face to face, but all of a sudden he was meeting people across the table

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: a hundred yards away or whatever, 10 yards away, it was very hard. Perhaps he lost touch with

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: contact with people. So it's not just power, it's the very simple fact that you're just-

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Actually, I'm speculating. I don't know. I see that. And I also, perhaps he thought in his mind

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: we mentioned Elon Musk and there's a way that people sound when they speak freely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: When I speak to, I have family in Ukraine, I have family in Russia. When I speak to people in Russia,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: let's put my family aside, when I speak to people in Russia, I think there's fear.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: I think they don't, sometimes when you call for the overthrow of government, that's important,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: not because you necessarily believe for the overthrow of the government, but you just need

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: to test, test the power centers and make sure they're responsive to the people. And I feel like

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: there's a mix of fear and apathy that has a different texture than it does in the United States.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: That worries me because I would like to see the flourishing of a people in all places.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Well, as I said, my impression was that there's far more freedom in the press than was pictured

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: by the West. And that means different points of view because the Russians are always arguing with

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: themselves. I've never seen a country that's so contentious. There's more intellectuals in Moscow

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: and the cities than you can believe. And you know the Russian people there. They've been fighting

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: government for years back from the 1870s, it was czarist times, they're always plotting against

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: the government. And the intelligentsia has known through history as being contentious and anti-government

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: in many ways. And we see the same thing, educated people turning against Russia. I don't appreciate

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: those people because I think they're very spoiled and they don't understand some of the stuff that's

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: going on in the West. But we have a lot of Russians in Europe and America that attack Russia and

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: sometimes don't understand that they are under pressure from the United States and they don't

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: understand the size of the pressure. And that's why Putin connects with the people because he

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: represents the common, more the common man who's saying to you, your interests are threatened,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Russia is threatened. We are representing only the interests of Russia. We're not an empire,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: we're not going to expand. He has no empire intentions, although the West paints it as empire.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: I see no evidence of it. Why didn't he do something in all these years? Nothing. He did

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: nothing except defend the country in Georgia and in Chechnya. So the imperialists are trying to

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: defend Georgia. So the imperialist imperative is coming more from the West.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: It's the imperialist agenda. Going back to, I'm sorry, where we left our discussion off, I mean,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: I was going to go on with America not only being censored, closed down now, closed down. And you

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: say it's not fear. Well, it is fear. I am scared because if you get your Facebook page suspended

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: or your YouTube, your Twitter account thrown off, a lot of good people are getting their thrown off.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: You can't say, you can't speak out. It affects your business. It goes back to the 1950s when

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: my father's world, when you could not express any sympathy for a Soviet Union without endangering

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: your job, without basically being not trusted. You had to be part of the program to get along,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: to go along. Same thing when United Kingdom, I mean, for all their talk, this Boris Johnson is

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: an idiot, but all their talk about, do you remember their policies with the IRA in Ireland when Ireland

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: was threatening them? They cut off the IRA completely. Jerry Adams, who was a wonderful

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: guy, I met him, was not allowed to even be heard in Britain during certain years. In France,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: all constantly through the Algerian War, the Algerians were not allowed to be heard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: The Algerian War for Independence divided France greatly. You could not even show Paz of Glory,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: a World War I film in France for, I don't know, 20 years after it came out. Censorship is a way

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: of life when democracies also feel threatened. They are much more fragile than they pretend to be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: A healthy democracy would take all the criticism in the world and shrug it off and say, okay,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: that's what's good about our country. Well, I'd like to see that in America. There are times

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: that it's been like that, but it's so scary now. So it is scary. That's what I was trying to say.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: It's not unscary to me. In China, I would say to you, yes, it's much scarier to me because

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: there is the internet wall that they cut off. And I got into problems in China too because I said

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: something years ago about you have to discover your own history. You have to be honest about Mao.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: You have to go back and admit, let's make a movie about Mao. That upset them and show his negatives.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: So China has been much more sensitive than Russia about criticism, much more. And it is a source of

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: problems. But on the other hand, China has a lot of grievances, a lot going back to the 19th century

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: and the British imperialism of that era and the American imperialism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: If you could talk to Vladimir Putin once again now, what kind of things would you talk about here?

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: What kind of questions would you ask?

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Well, one thing I would certainly ask is what you were thinking on February 23.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: And I would ask him to reply to my question about what if you took this to phase two, you surrendered

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: in Donbass, you know ego about it, you just surrendered, it's in your interest of your country

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: and you invited all the refugees from Donbass into Russia as much as they can. What would you do now?

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: What's the US next move in your opinion? How are you going to – okay, where are we going to go?

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: That would be the key question because it's – but he didn't go that way. He chose to take the

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: sanctions and to go this way. Why he did that is a key question for our time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Perhaps it was a mistake, perhaps it was his judgment, perhaps as I said, but I don't – knowing

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: the man I did, I don't think so. I think it was calculated.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Now, this is projection and speculation, but there is something different about him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: In the past several months, it could be the COVID thing, the isolation that you mentioned.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Yeah. I've listened to a lot of interviews and speeches in Russian and there's something about

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: power over time that can change you, that can isolate you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Well, when I was there – no, he'd been in office for already 15 years. He had power. He didn't

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: misuse it in my opinion. He was very even. I saw him go on television and talk to his fellows the

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: same way he always talked to them. He grew with it. He grew in intelligence and knowledge because

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: he had dealings with the whole world. Now, people had come to him. He was very well known in Africa

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: and Middle East, certainly Syria. I just never saw misuse of his power. I saw humility in him actually.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: So perhaps there was a calculation and he calculated wrong in terms of what happens

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: if he doesn't invade. Perhaps there was a calculation, perhaps he had a calm and clear mind

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: and he calculated wrong. Well, he also made the point that he – the talk of Zelensky saying

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: nuclear weapons were going to come into Ukraine. There was talk about that right before

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: the invasion too. Certainly that would have set off alarms. The United States is already kind of

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: doing that by not only putting its intelligence and its heavy weaponry into Ukraine, but you've

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: got to deal with the question. The next question that comes up, the most immediate question is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: is the United States going to start – and I'm saying this is – they're making a lot of noise

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: in the United States press about Russia using nuclear weapons and chemical weapons. That's a

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: lot of noise. Again, going back to my analogy, when the United States starts that, it starts the

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: conversation going. It's in the interest of the United States for Russia to be pinned with any kind

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: of chemical or nuclear incident. For example, it'd be very – not simple, but it would be possible

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: to explode a nuclear device in Donbass and kill thousands of people. We would not know right away

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: who did it, but of course the blame would go right to Russia, right to Russia, even if it didn't make

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: sense, if there was no motivation for it. It would just be blamed on Russia. The United States might

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: well be the one who does that false flag operation. It would not be beyond them. It would be a very

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: dramatic solution to sealing this war off as a major victory for the United States.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: That's terrifying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: No, but it can happen. It can happen. A one kiloton device, low yield, it's possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: When you walk across that line, you can potentially never walk back.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Well, I think the United States is calculating that it's a dangerous – yes, I agree,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: but I think the neoconservative arrogance is such that they really believe they can push their

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: advantage to the max now because of all these propaganda successes up to now. The Ukrainian

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: army could be wiped out for all we know. There's all this left is their neo-Nazi brigades, but

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: they're being advised very well by US and they're sending the weapons in, or huge amounts of weapons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: What about American budget? No one talks about how much money we're giving to Ukraine. It's a

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: billion dollars already in weaponry and not most of it just poured in. What about – the Russian

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: defense budget is 60 some billion dollars a year. It's nothing compared to the United States,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: one-fifteenth of it, but yet we put so much weaponry into Ukraine. The money we've spent on Ukraine is

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: equivalent almost to what we spent on COVID in our own country. It's astounding the distortion

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: of our priorities. There's also chemical. Don't forget, chemical is probably the easier way to go,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: but in Syria there was far too many incidents of America in its quest to demonize Assad and

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: the Russians of all these chemical attacks that were happening that they were vowing came from

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Russia. In spite of the fact that Russia signed the agreement on chemical arms and

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: – and apparently destroyed its stock several years ago, it's strange that the strangest

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: incidents happened in Syria. You go back to trace everyone, good journalism was done. The

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: White Helmets got a lot of fame, but they were corrupted and many good journalists tried to point

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: out the inconsistencies in the American accusations. Robert Perry among them, who was one of my mentors

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: at Consortium Press, a lot of good – you'd have to go back, but trace each – like you would trace

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: each time they made an accusation against Putin of murder, you need that same kind of Sherlock Holmes

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: intensity investigation. And they don't do it because the United Nations or the chemical – not

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: the United Nations as much as the chemical people, the organization has been tampered with. If you

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: remember correctly, there was accusations that the chemical investigative unit, I don't know the name

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: of it, was tampered with. And people quit. People who were working on that commission quit and said

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: that this is not legit. It's very interesting. That Syria story is wacko. So the United States

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: is willing to use chemical in Syria freely. It did it three, four times. If you remember correctly,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Trump was challenged that he did not attack after a chemical incident in Syria. All these newscasters

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: in the United States, the most heaviest of them were saying, well, President Putin is – President

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Trump is now finally acting like a real precedent when he attacks – when he drops missiles in Syria.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: They actually said that. In other words, they wanted Trump to go to war on Syria, but he didn't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Chemical weapons – Chemical and nuclear. Nuclear is really terrifying. Do you think – now,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: combine this with the fascinating choice in your interviews with Vladimir Putin to watch

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Stanley Kubrick's – Dr. Strange. Dr. Strange love or how I learned to stop worrying and love

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: the bomb. And given the fact that you did that, now looking at the fact that the word nuclear,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: and it feels like the world hangs on the brink of nuclear war, do you think that's overstating the

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: case? No. That's what worried me from the beginning, and that's probably why I got involved

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: in all this stuff because I go back to the 60s when I was a – when we were so close to nuclear war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: I lived through that period, and I thought, as many people did, that this was – it was going to

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: – it was going to come now. So I've lived through that, and I didn't sense the period in 83 when

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Reagan took us to the edge, if you remember correctly. Able Archer was an exercise that

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: almost brought us to – the Russians were really paranoid at that point, and they were responding

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: to our military exercise on Able Archer. There was also the Korean airliner they went down.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: There were numerous incidents in the 80s, but I never felt the fear.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: I thought Reagan was testing the limits, but perhaps if I'd been younger, I would have felt it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: But anyway, no, we come close. The United States has risked this several times. If I told you,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: it would be hard for you to believe. If I could set a scene for you in a drama in 1962 when Kennedy

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: has a meeting with the Joint Chiefs of Staff and the CIA, and they talk about a plan,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: a plan, a military plan to first strike the Soviet Union and China, okay? It was called – it was an

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Eisenhower plan that had been put into – put into potential operation in the – in early 60s or 50s,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: late 50s, SiOP 62. This was an attack on the Soviet Union, first strike. That's why the United

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: States has never given up the concept of first strike. It's interesting that the Russian

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: nuclear policy posture is more defensive than the American one, which leaves options open.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: The same options are open in neoconservative agreements that we see from the late 90s where

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: they say the emergence of a rival power will not be tolerated. That's a very broad statement,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: and it allows you to do a lot, including nuclear. So you have to understand the United States is

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: always – first of all, it breaks so many treaties. We know that from the Putin story about

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: the anti-ballistic missile treaty in 2002 and then the INF treaty of – they broke that one. That was

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: the intermediate missile – that was 2019. I don't know when they broke it off, but the United States

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: has not been very faithful on its nuclear agreements. So I don't know that we can even

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: deal with the United States diplomatically. It seems to be impossible. Now, brings me to Biden.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: Yes. Another Irishman.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: This is the opposite of Kennedy. Kennedy was a Catholic Irish anti-imperialist. Biden seems

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: to be the opposite. He seems to be a get-along-go-along guy who's been not only old,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: but he's also gone along with this program, which I voted for Biden because I feared Trump,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: but I thought Biden at a certain age would mellow. I really did. He's not mellowed. Apparently,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: he's still listening to these people and he believes them. It seems that his – that horrible

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: woman, Victoria Nuland, who was under Secretary of State, he appointed her to this sector of the

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: world. She's very influential, and she's been one of the worst people on Ukraine. Obviously,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: she's behind the coup. She was the one who boasted that we got our man in, Yats, whatever

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: it is, Yatsenuk, and also, remember the famous statement, fuck the EU, all these things. But

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: she's back and she said the other day about if the Russians use nuclear weaponry of any kind,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: there's going to be a horrible price to pay. She was out of the blue. I said, what the hell is she

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: doing? She's talking nuclear all of a sudden. Then since that day, everybody in the US press,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: all the shows have gone talk nuclear, nuclear, nuclear. Secretary of State has done it, Blinken.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: It scares you. If you think about it, the United States scares me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: So that's the military industrial complex machine, fully functional, fully operational behind this

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286

body.input: whole thing. Is that what's to blame? It certainly is. That's why I showed him

metadata.title: Podcast: Oliver Stone: Vladimir Putin and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #286
