body.input: as decomposed into really three different pieces.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: There's the model, which can be something like a neural net

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: or a Bolton machine or a recurrent model.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And that basically just describes how do you take data

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and how do you take parameters?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And what function do you use to make a prediction

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: given the data and the parameters?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Another piece of the learning algorithm

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: is the optimization algorithm.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Or not every algorithm can be really described

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: in terms of optimization, but what's the algorithm

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: for updating the parameters or updating whatever the state

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: of the network is?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And then the last part is the data set,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: like how do you actually represent the world

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: as it comes into your machine learning system?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So I think of deep learning as telling us something

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: about what does the model look like?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And basically to qualify as deep,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: I say that it just has to have multiple layers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: That can be multiple steps

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: in a feedforward differentiable computation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: That can be multiple layers in a graphical model.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: There's a lot of ways that you could satisfy me

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that something has multiple steps that are each

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: parameterized separately.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: I think of gradient descent as being all about

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that other piece, how do you actually update

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: the parameters piece?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So you could imagine having a deep model

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: like a convolutional net and training it with something

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: like evolution or a genetic algorithm.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And I would say that still qualifies as deep learning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And then in terms of models

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that aren't necessarily differentiable,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: I guess Bolton machines are probably the main example

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: of something where you can't really take a derivative

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and use that for the learning process.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: of processing that it applies

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: when you run inference in the model.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So it's the steps of processing that's key.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So Jeff Hinton suggests that we need to throw away

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: back propagation and start all over.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: What do you think about that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: What could an alternative direction

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: of training neural networks look like?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: I don't know that back propagation

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: is gonna go away entirely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Most of this time when we decide

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that a machine learning algorithm isn't on the critical path

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: to research for improving AI, the algorithm doesn't die.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: A lot of algorithms like logistic regression

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: don't seem that exciting to AI researchers

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: But there's still a lot of use for logistic regression

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and things like analyzing really noisy data

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: in medicine and finance,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: in really time-limited contexts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So I think back propagation and gradient descent

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: are around to stay, but they may not end up being

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So I have noticed in general

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that I'm less prone to shooting down some of my ideas

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: I think if I had had that idea at lunchtime,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: I probably would have thought,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: it's hard enough to train one neural net.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: You can't train a second neural net

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: in the inner loop of the outer neural net.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: That was basically my friend's objection

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: was that trying to train two neural nets at the same time

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: would be too hard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So it was more about the training process unless,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: so my skepticism would be, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: I'm sure you could train it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: but the thing would converge to would not be able

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: to generate anything reasonable,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: any kind of reasonable realism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Yeah, so part of what all of us were thinking about

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: when we had this conversation was deep Bolton machines,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: which a lot of us in the lab, including me,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: were a big fan of deep Bolton machines at the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: They involved two separate processes

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: running at the same time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: One of them is called the positive phase

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: where you load data into the model

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and tell the model to make the data more likely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: The other one is called the negative phase

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: where you draw samples from the model

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and tell the model to make those samples less likely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: In a deep Bolton machine,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: it's not trivial to generate a sample.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: You have to actually run an iterative process

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that gets better and better samples

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: coming closer and closer to the distribution

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: the model represents.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So during the training process,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: you're always running these two systems at the same time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: One that's updating the parameters of the model

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and another one that's trying to generate

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: samples from the model.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And they worked really well on things like MNIST,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: but a lot of us in the lab, including me,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: had tried to get deep Bolton machines

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: to scale past MNIST to things like generating color photos

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and we just couldn't get the two processes

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: to stay synchronized.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So when I had the idea for GANs,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: a lot of people thought that the discriminator

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: would have more or less the same problem

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: as the negative phase in the Bolton machine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: That trying to train the discriminator in the inner loop,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: you just couldn't get it to keep up

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: with the generator in the outer loop.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And that would prevent it from converging

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: to anything useful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Yeah, I share that intuition.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: But turns out to not be the case.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: A lot of the time with machine learning algorithms,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: it's really hard to predict ahead of time

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: how well they'll actually perform.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: You have to just run the experiment and see what happens.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And I would say I still today don't have like one factor

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: I can put my finger on and say this is why GANs

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: worked for photo generation and deep Bolton machines don't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: There are a lot of theory papers showing that

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: under some theoretical settings,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: the GAN algorithm does actually converge.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: But those settings are restricted enough

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that they don't necessarily explain the whole picture

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: in terms of all the results that we see in practice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So taking a step back, can you in the same way

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: as we talked about deep learning,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: can you tell me what generative adversarial networks are?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Yeah, so generative adversarial networks

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: are a particular kind of generative model.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: A generative model is a machine learning model

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that can train on some set of data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Like say you have a collection of photos of cats

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and you want to generate more photos of cats,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: or you want to estimate a probability distribution over cats

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: so you can ask how likely it is that some new image

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: is a photo of a cat.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: GANs are one way of doing this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Some generative models are good at creating new data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Other generative models are good at estimating

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that density function and telling you how likely

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: particular pieces of data are to come

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: from the same distribution as the training data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: GANs are more focused on generating samples

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: rather than estimating the density function.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: There are some kinds of GANs like flow GAN that can do both,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: but mostly GANs are about generating samples,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: generating new photos of cats that look realistic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And they do that completely from scratch.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: It's analogous to human imagination.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: When a GAN creates a new image of a cat,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: it's using a neural network to produce a cat

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that has not existed before.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: It isn't doing something like compositing photos together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: You're not literally taking the eye off of one cat

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and the ear off of another cat.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: It's more of this digestive process

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: where the neural net trains on a lot of data

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and comes up with some representation

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: of the probability distribution

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and generates entirely new cats.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: There are a lot of different ways

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: of building a generative model.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: What's specific to GANs is that we have a two-player game

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: in the game theoretic sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And as the players in this game compete,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: one of them becomes able to generate realistic data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: The first player is called the generator.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: It produces output data such as just images, for example.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And at the start of the learning process,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: it'll just produce completely random images.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: The other player is called the discriminator.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: The discriminator takes images as input

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and guesses whether they're real or fake.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: You train it both on real data,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: so photos that come from your training set,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: actual photos of cats,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and you train it to say that those are real.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: You also train it on images

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that come from the generator network.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And you train it to say that those are fake.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: As the two players compete in this game,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: the discriminator tries to become better

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: at recognizing whether images are real or fake.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And the generator becomes better at fooling the discriminator

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: into thinking that its outputs are real.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And you can analyze this through the language of game theory

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and find that there's a Nash equilibrium

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: where the generator has captured

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: the correct probability distribution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So in the cat example,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: it makes perfectly realistic cat photos.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And the discriminator is unable to do better

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: than random guessing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: because all the samples coming from both the data

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and the generator look equally likely

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: to have come from either source.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So do you ever sit back and does it just blow your mind

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that this thing works?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So from very, so it's able to estimate

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that density function enough to generate realistic images.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: I mean, yeah, do you ever sit back?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: I mean, how does this even, why this is quite incredible,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: especially where GANs have gone in terms of realism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Yeah, and not just to flatter my own work,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: but generative models, all of them have this property

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that if they really did what we ask them to do,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: they would do nothing but memorize the training data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Right, exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Models that are based on maximizing the likelihood,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: the way that you obtain the maximum likelihood

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: for a specific training set is you assign

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: all of your probability mass to the training examples

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and nowhere else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: For GANs, the game is played using a training set.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So the way that you become unbeatable in the game

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: is you literally memorize training examples.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: One of my former interns wrote a paper,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: his name is Vaishnav Nagarajan,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and he showed that it's actually hard for the generator

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: to memorize the training data,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: hard in a statistical learning theory sense,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that you can actually create reasons

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: for why it would require quite a lot of learning steps

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and a lot of observations of different latent variables

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: before you could memorize the training data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: That still doesn't really explain why,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: when you produce samples that are new,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: why do you get compelling images rather than just garbage

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that's different from the training set.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And I don't think we really have a good answer for that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: especially if you think about how many possible images

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: are out there and how few images

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: the generative model sees during training.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: It seems just unreasonable that generative models

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: create new images as well as they do,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: especially considering that we're basically training them

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: to memorize rather than generalize.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: I think part of the answer is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: there's a paper called Deep Image Prior,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: where they show that you can take a convolutional net

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and you don't even need to learn the parameters of it at all,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: you just use the model architecture.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And it's already useful for things like in-painting images.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: I think that shows us that the convolutional network

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: architecture captures something really important

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: about the structure of images.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And we don't need to actually use the learning

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: to capture all the information

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: coming out of the convolutional net.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: That would imply that it would be much harder

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: to make generative models in other domains.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So far, we're able to make reasonable speech models

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and things like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: But to be honest, we haven't actually explored

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: a whole lot of different data sets all that much.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: We don't, for example, see a lot of deep learning models

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: of biology data sets,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: where you have lots of microarrays measuring

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: the amount of different enzymes and things like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So we may find that some of the progress

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that we've seen for images and speech

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: turns out to really rely heavily on the model architecture.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And we were able to do what we did for vision

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: by trying to reverse engineer the human visual system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And maybe it'll turn out that we can't just use

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that same trick for arbitrary kinds of data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Right, so there's aspect to the human vision system,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: the hardware of it that makes it without learning,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: without cognition, just makes it really effective

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: at detecting the patterns we see in the visual world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Yeah, that's really interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So what, in a big, quick overview,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: in your view, what types of GANs are there

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and what other generative models besides GANs are there?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Yeah, so it's maybe a little bit easier to start

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: with what kinds of generative models

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: are there other than GANs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So most generative models are likelihood-based,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: where to train them, you have a model that tells you

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: how much probability it assigns to a particular example,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and you just maximize the probability assigned

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: to all the training examples.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: It turns out that it's hard to design a model

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that can create really complicated images

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: or really complicated audio waveforms

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and still have it be possible to estimate

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: the likelihood function from a computational point of view.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Most interesting models that you would just write down

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: intuitively, it turns out that it's almost impossible

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: to calculate the amount of probability

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: they assign to a particular point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So there's a few different schools of generative models

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: in the likelihood family.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: One approach is to very carefully design the model

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: so that it is computationally tractable

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: to measure the density it assigns to a particular point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So there are things like autoregressive models,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: like pixel CNN, those basically break down

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: the probability distribution into a product

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: over every single feature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So for an image, you estimate the probability of each pixel

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: given all of the pixels that came before it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: There's tricks where if you want to measure

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: the density function, you can actually calculate

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: the density for all these pixels more or less in parallel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Generating the image still tends to require you

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: to go one pixel at a time, and that can be very slow.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: But there are, again, tricks for doing this

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: in a hierarchical pattern where you can keep

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: the runtime under control.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Are the quality of the images it generates,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: putting runtime aside, pretty good?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: They're reasonable, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: I would say a lot of the best results

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: are from GANs these days, but it can be hard to tell

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: how much of that is based on who's studying

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: which type of algorithm, if that makes sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: The amount of effort invested in a particular algorithm.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Yeah, or like the kind of expertise.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So a lot of people who have traditionally been excited

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: about graphics or art and things like that

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: have gotten interested in GANs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And to some extent, it's hard to tell,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: are GANs doing better because they have a lot of

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: graphics and art experts behind them?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Or are GANs doing better because they're more

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: computationally efficient?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Or are GANs doing better because they prioritize

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: the realism of samples over the accuracy

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: of the density function?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: I think all of those are potentially valid explanations,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and it's hard to tell.

body.input: So can you give a brief history of GANs from 2014,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: were you paper 13?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Yeah, so a few highlights.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: In the first paper, we just showed that GANs basically work.
