body.input: and then scaling up to high res,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: but they were able to get it to work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And then in 2015, I believe later that same year,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Alec Radford and Sumit Chintala and Luke Metz

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: published the DCGAN paper,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: which it stands for Deep Convolutional GAN.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: It's kind of a non-unique name

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: because these days basically all GANs

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and even some before that were deep and convolutional,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: but they just kind of picked a name

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: for a really great recipe where they were able

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: to actually using only one model

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: instead of a multi-step process,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: actually generate realistic images of faces

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and things like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: That was sort of like the beginning

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: of the Cambrian explosion of GANs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Like once you had animals that had a backbone,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: you suddenly got lots of different versions of fish

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and four-legged animals and things like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So DCGAN became kind of the backbone

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: for many different models that came out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Used as a baseline even still.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Yeah, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And so from there, I would say some interesting things

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: we've seen are, there's a lot you can say

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: about how just the quality of standard image generation

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: GANs has increased, but what's also maybe more interesting

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: on an intellectual level is how the things you can use GANs

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: for has also changed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: One thing is that you can use them to learn classifiers

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: without having to have class labels for every example

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: in your training set.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So that's called semi-supervised learning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: My colleague at OpenAI, Tim Salamans, who's at Brain now,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: wrote a paper called Improved Techniques for Training GANs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: I'm a coauthor on this paper,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: but I can't claim any credit for this particular part.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: One thing he showed on the paper is that you can take

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: the GAN discriminator and use it as a classifier

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that actually tells you, this image is a cat,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: this image is a dog, this image is a car,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: this image is a truck.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And so, not just to say whether the image is real or fake,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: but if it is real to say specifically

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: what kind of object it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And he found that you can train these classifiers

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: with far fewer labeled examples than traditional classifiers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So if you supervise based on also,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: not just your discrimination ability,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: but your ability to classify, you're going to do much,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: you're going to converge much faster to being effective

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: at being discriminator.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So for example, for the MNIST dataset,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: you want to look at an image of a handwritten digit

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and say whether it's a zero, a one, or a two, and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: To get down to less than 1% accuracy required

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: around 60,000 examples until maybe about 2014 or so.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: In 2016 with this semi-supervised GAN project,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Tim was able to get below 1% error

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: using only 100 labeled examples.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So that was about a 600X decrease

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: in the amount of labels that he needed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: He's still using more images than that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: but he doesn't need to have each of them labeled as,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: this one's a one, this one's a two,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: this one's a zero, and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Then to be able to, for GANs to be able

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: to generate recognizable objects,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: so objects from a particular class,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: you still need labeled data

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: because you need to know what it means

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: to be a particular class cat dog.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: How do you think we can move away from that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Yeah, some researchers at Brain Zurich

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: actually just released a really great paper

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: on semi-supervised GANs where their goal isn't to classify,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: it's to make recognizable objects

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: despite not having a lot of labeled data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: They were working off of DeepMind's BigGAN project,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and they showed that they can match the performance

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: of BigGAN using only 10%, I believe, of the labels.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: BigGAN was trained on the ImageNet data set,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: which is about 1.2 million images,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and had all of them labeled.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: This latest project from Brain Zurich shows

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that they're able to get away with only having

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: about 10% of the images labeled.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And they do that essentially using a clustering algorithm

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: where the discriminator learns to assign the objects

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: to groups, and then this understanding

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that objects can be grouped into similar types

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: helps it to form more realistic ideas

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: of what should be appearing in the image,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: because it knows that every image it creates

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: has to come from one of these archetypal groups

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: rather than just being some arbitrary image.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: If you train a GAN with no class labels,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: you tend to get things that look sort of like grass

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: or water or brick or dirt,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: but without necessarily a lot going on in them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And I think that's partly because if you look

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: at a large ImageNet image,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: the object doesn't necessarily occupy the whole image.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And so you learn to create realistic sets of pixels,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: but you don't necessarily learn that the object

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: is the star of the show,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and you want it to be in every image you make.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Yeah, I've heard you talk about the horse,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: the zebra cycle, GAN mapping, and how it turns out, again,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: thought provoking that horses are usually on grass

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and zebras are usually on drier terrain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So when you're doing that kind of generation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: you're going to end up generating greener horses

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: or whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So those are connected together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: It's not just, you're not able to segment,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: be able to generate in a segmental way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So are there other types of games you come across

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: in your mind that neural networks can play with each other

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: to be able to solve problems?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Yeah, the one that I spend most of my time on is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: in security, you can model most interactions as a game

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: where there's attackers trying to break your system

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and you're the defender trying to build a resilient system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: There's also domain adversarial learning,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: which is an approach to domain adaptation

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that looks really a lot like GANs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: The authors had the idea before the GAN paper came out,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: their paper came out a little bit later.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And they're very nice and cited the GAN paper,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: but I know that they actually had the idea

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: before it came out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Domain adaptation is when you want to train

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: a machine learning model in one setting called a domain

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and then deploy it in another domain later.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And you would like it to perform well in the new domain,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: even though the new domain is different

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: from how it was trained.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So for example, you might want to train

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: on a really clean image data set like ImageNet,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: but then deploy on users' phones

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: where the user is taking pictures in the dark

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and pictures while moving quickly

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and just pictures that aren't really centered

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: or composed all that well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: When you take a normal machine learning model,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: it often degrades really badly

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: when you move to the new domain

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: because it looks so different

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: from what the model was trained on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Domain adaptation algorithms try to smooth out that gap.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And the domain adversarial approach

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: is based on training a feature extractor

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: where the features have the same statistics

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: regardless of which domain you extracted them on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So in the domain adversarial game,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: you have one player that's a feature extractor

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and another player that's a domain recognizer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: The domain recognizer wants to look at the output

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: of the feature extractor

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and guess which of the two domains the features came from.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So it's a lot like the real versus fake discriminator

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: in GANs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And then the feature extractor,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: you can think of as loosely analogous

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: to the generator in GANs,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: except what it's trying to do here is

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: both fool the domain recognizer

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: into not knowing which domain the data came from

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and also extract features that are good for classification.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So at the end of the day,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: you can, in the cases where it works out,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: you can actually get features

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that work about the same in both domains.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Sometimes this has a drawback where

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: in order to make things work the same in both domains,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: it just gets worse at the first one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: But there are a lot of cases

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: where it actually works out well on both.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Do you think of GANs being useful

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: in the context of data augmentation?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Yeah, one thing you could hope for with GANs

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: is you could imagine I've got a limited training set

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and I'd like to make more training data

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: to train something else like a classifier.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: You could train the GAN on the training set

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and then create more data

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and then maybe the classifier would perform better

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: on the test set after training

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: on this bigger GAN generated data set.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So that's the simplest version

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: of something you might hope would work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: I've never heard of that particular approach working,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: but I think there's some closely related things

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that I think could work in the future

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and some that actually already have worked.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So if we think a little bit about what we'd be hoping for

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: if we use the GAN to make more training data,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: we're hoping that the GAN will generalize to new examples

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: better than the classifier would have generalized

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: if it was trained on the same data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And I don't know of any reason to believe

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that the GAN would generalize better

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: than the classifier would,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: but what we might hope for is that the GAN

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: could generalize differently from a specific classifier.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So one thing I think is worth trying

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that I haven't personally tried, but someone could try is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: what if you trained a whole lot of different generative models

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: on the same training set,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: create samples from all of them,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and then train a classifier on that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Because each of the generative models

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: might generalize in a slightly different way,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: they might capture many different axes of variation

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that one individual model wouldn't,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and then the classifier can capture all of those ideas

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: by training on all of their data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So it'd be a little bit like making an ensemble

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: of classifiers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And I think that-

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: An ensemble of GANs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: In a way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: I think that could generalize better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: The other thing that GANs are really good for

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: is not necessarily generating new data

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that's exactly like what you already have,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: but by generating new data that has different properties

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: from the data you already had.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: One thing that you can do is you can create

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: differentially private data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So suppose that you have something like medical records

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and you don't want to train a classifier

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: on the medical records and then publish the classifier

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: because someone might be able to reverse engineer

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: some of the medical records you trained on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: There's a paper from Casey Green's lab

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that shows how you can train a GAN

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: using differential privacy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And then the samples from the GAN

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: still have the same differential privacy guarantees

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: as the parameters of the GAN.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So you can make fake patient data

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: for other researchers to use.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And they can do almost anything they want with that data

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: because it doesn't come from real people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And the differential privacy mechanism gives you

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: clear guarantees on how much the original people's data

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: has been protected.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: That's really interesting actually.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: I haven't heard you talk about that before.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: In terms of fairness, I've seen from AAAI, your talk,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: how can adversarial machine learning help models

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: be more fair with respect to sensitive variables?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Yeah, so there's a paper from Amos Storky's lab

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: about how to learn machine learning models

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that are incapable of using specific variables.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So say for example, you wanted to make predictions

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that are not affected by gender.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: It isn't enough to just leave gender

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: out of the input to the model.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: You can often infer gender

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: from a lot of other characteristics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Like say that you have the person's name

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: but you're not told their gender.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Well, if their name is Ian, they're kind of obviously a man.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So what you'd like to do is make a machine learning model

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that can still take in a lot of different attributes

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and make a really accurate informed prediction,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: but be confident that it isn't reverse engineering gender

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: or another sensitive variable internally.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: You can do that using something very similar

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: to the domain adversarial approach

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: where you have one player that's a feature extractor

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and another player that's a feature analyzer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And you want to make sure that the feature analyzer

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: is not able to guess the value of the sensitive variable

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that you're trying to keep private.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Right, yeah, I love this approach.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So with the feature, you're not able to infer

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: the sensitive variables.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Brilliant, that's quite brilliant and simple actually.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Another way I think that GANs in particular

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: could be used for fairness would be to make something

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: like a cycle GAN where you can take data from one domain

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and convert it into another.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: We've seen cycle GAN turning horses into zebras.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: We've seen other unsupervised GANs made by Ming Yu Liu

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: doing things like turning day photos into night photos.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: I think for fairness, you could imagine

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: taking records for people in one group

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and transforming them into analogous people

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: in another group and testing to see

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: if they're treated equitably across those two groups.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: There's a lot of things that'd be hard to get right

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: to make sure that the conversion process itself is fair.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And I don't think it's anywhere near something

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that we could actually use yet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: But if you could design that conversion process

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: very carefully, it might give you a way of doing audits

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: where you say, what if we took people from this group,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: converted them into equivalent people in another group?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Does the system actually treat them how it ought to?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: That's also really interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: You know, in popular press and in general,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: in our imagination, you think,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: well, GANs are able to generate data

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and you start to think about deep fakes

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: or being able to sort of maliciously generate data

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that fakes the identity of other people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Is this something of a concern to you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Is this something, if you look 10, 20 years into the future,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: is that something that pops up in your work

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: in the work of the community

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that's working on generating models?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: I'm a lot less concerned about 20 years from now

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: than the next few years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: I think there will be a kind of bumpy cultural transition

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: as people encounter this idea

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that there can be very realistic videos

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and audio that aren't real.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: I think 20 years from now, people will mostly understand

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that you shouldn't believe something is real

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: just because you saw a video of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: People will expect to see

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that it's been cryptographically signed

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: or have some other mechanism to make them believe

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that the content is real.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: There's already people working on this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Like there's a startup called TruePic

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that provides a lot of mechanisms for authenticating

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that an image is real.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: They're maybe not quite up to having a state actor

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: try to evade their verification techniques,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: but it's something that people are already working on

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and I think will get right eventually.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So you think authentication will eventually win out?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So being able to authenticate that this is real

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and this is not, as opposed to GANs

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: just getting better and better

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: or generative models being able to get better and better

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: to where the nature of what is real is normal?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: I don't think we'll ever be able to look at the pixels

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: of a photo and tell you for sure

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that it's real or not real.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that would be a huge leap forward,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So you have a very clear, calm way of speaking,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: no ums, easy to edit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: I've seen comments for both you and I

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Just being able to talk the way out of it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Proving that I'm not a robot with today's technology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Yeah, that's pretty straightforward.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: But I guess more generally, trying to prove

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: of my GAN research, that you can simulate almost anything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And so you have to really step back to a separate channel

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: to prove that something is real.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So like, I guess I should have had myself stamped

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: but I didn't do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So according to my own research methodology,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: there's just no way to know at this point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So what, last question, problem stands out for you

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: in the near future?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So I think resistance to adversarial examples,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: figuring out how to make machine learning secure

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: against an adversary who wants to interfere it

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and control it is one of the most important things

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: researchers today could solve.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: In all domains, image, language, driving, and everything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: I guess I'm most concerned about domains

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: we haven't really encountered yet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Like, imagine 20 years from now when we're using

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: advanced AIs to do things we haven't even thought of yet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Like if you ask people, what are the important problems

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: in security of phones in like 2002,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: I don't think we would have anticipated that we're using

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: them for nearly as many things as we're using them

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: for today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: I think it's gonna be like that with AI

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that you can kind of try to speculate about

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: where it's going, but really the business opportunities

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that end up taking off would be hard to predict

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: ahead of time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: What you can predict ahead of time is that

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: almost anything you can do with machine learning,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: you would like to make sure that people can't get it

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: to do what they want rather than what you want

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: And you think that the set of methodology to do that

body.input: can be bigger than any one domain?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: I think so, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: Yeah, like one methodology that I think is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: not a specific methodology, but like a category of solutions

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that I'm excited about today is making dynamic models

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that change every time they make a prediction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: So right now we tend to train models

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and then after they're trained, we freeze them

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and we just use the same rule to classify everything

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: that comes in from then on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: That's really a sitting duck from a security point of view.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: so that it's harder to predict what you're gonna get

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: will make it harder for an adversary

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: to really take control of the system

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: and make it do what they want it to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Goodfellow: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) | Lex Fridman Podcast #19

body.input: The following is a conversation with Eric Schmidt.
